'''Bring Down the Strongest Pokémon!!''' (Japanese: '''最強ポケモンをぶったおせ！！''' ''Bring Down the Strongest Pokémon!!'') is the twenty-fifth chapter of the [[Pokémon Pocket Monsters]] manga.

==Plot==
{{incomplete plot}}

==Major events==
* {{PPM|Giovanni}} kidnaps Bill and his wife in order to create {{TP|Blue|Mewtwo}}, and has Bill forced to finish it.
* Giovanni successfully gets a {{p|Mew}} to make his creation complete.
* Mewtwo, after receiving Clefairy's DNA, is released along with Mew.
